info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Account Owners-spec
info.description: The Account Owners Retrieval API allows users to access detailed information about the owners of specified accounts tied to individual customers. Through a simple GET request, consumers can retrieve vital data regarding account ownership, which is essential for customer management and compliance. This API is particularly useful for financial institutions and customer service teams who require quick access to ownership details to enhance customer interactions and support services. Typical use cases include validating account ownership or facilitating account-related inquiries.

get.summary: Retrieve the owner of the specified account.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the owner information for a specific account associated with a customer. By providing the unique customer and account IDs, you can retrieve detailed ownership details.

requestBody.description: Request body to retrieve the owner details of a specific account associated with a customer. The request should specify the customer ID and account ID in the URI, and this body is used to define the expected output structure.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the owner information for the specified account.

ListAccountOwnersRequest.title: Owner Operations Request Body Schema
ListAccountOwnersRequest.description: This schema defines the request body for retrieving owner operations related to the specified customer and account.

asOfDate.description: The date when this information is valid, represented as an integer in UNIX timestamp format.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the response.

ListAccountOwnersResponse_200.description: This schema represents the owner details of an account in response to the API call.
